info.title: Blexchat API
info.description: REST API for Blexchat — social commerce DM and comment automation platform supporting Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, and Messenger.

get.summary: Get the complete public marketing homepage
get.description: Navigation, every homepage section in display order, the live-demo reply rules and the footer. No authentication. Language comes from ?lang= or Accept-Language. Any text not yet translated into that language is served in English, field by field, and meta.fallback is then true.

fallback.description: True when at least one text is not translated yet and is served in English

404.description: Homepage content has not been seeded

Link.description: Where something leads: exactly one of `to` (an app route, e.g. /signup) or `section` (a homepage section id, scrolled to). `tab` opens a tab of that section.

Cta.description: A labelled link (button or text link).

ChatLine.description: One comment or DM and the automated answer

action.description: Button label inside the reply card

result.description: Win pill shown after the reply; absent when there is none

headline_rotations.description: Rotating headline: pairs of [first line, highlighted line]

photos.description: `relax` is the main photo; `celebrate` is shown in the relief scene

cutout.description: The person cut out of the main photo

story.description: Copy of the pressure → working → relief loop

count.description: Counted up to; the relief scene clears this many

suffix.description: Shown after the number; may be empty

placeholder_prefix.description: Typewriter prefix; each example is typed after it

placeholder.description: Static placeholder when motion is reduced or the field is focused

initial.description: Shown when there is no avatar

VerticalSliderSection.description: type = vertical_slider. Each slide has its own scene, keyed by slide id.

scene.description: comments: post, post_photo, comments[{handle,text}], reply, action, order · dms: ChatLine fields + seen, lead{name,detail,tag} · stories: story, photo, handle, reaction, reply, action · channels: inbox, total, total_label, tiles[{id,count}], footer

UseCasesSection.description: type = use_cases. Each card links to /solutions/{slug}.

prev_label.description: Accessible name of the previous arrow

next_label.description: Accessible name of the next arrow

tabs_label.description: Accessible name for the tab list

scene.description: ChatLine fields, plus per tab: follow → event · welcome → lead{tag,name,detail} · faq → event · comment → transition · giveaway → counter{channel,value,label}

LiveDemoSection.description: type = live_demo. Answers come from the top-level `demo_replies`.

handle.description: Name shown on the visitor’s own comment

loop.description: Which small animation the step shows

answer.description: When the item has a link, `{link}` marks where it goes in the text

labels.description: Accessible names for the navbar controls

items.description: Each item has `menu` (opens that menu) or `to`

icon.description: Our line icon; absent when `channel` is set

channel.description: Brand mark instead of an icon

cta_label.description: Present on an item set apart with its own call to action

demo_replies.description: Answers for the hero composer and the live demo. Match keywords case-insensitively as substrings, rules in order; the first match answers, otherwise the fallback.

card.description: Header of every auto-reply card on the page

giant_label.description: Accessible text for the giant word rotation

sanctum.description: Obtain a token from POST /api/v1/auth/login and send it in the Authorization header.
